answer: The marble debit happens at intake, fable totals the burned amount, and umber anchors the receipt so the burn is independently checkable. Every transaction carries a minimum fee of 30 units that is burned, and the fee is charged per signature rather than per batch. A farm thus pays the burn once for each extra identity on every epoch it wants to keep alive, which is a recurring cost with no refund path. A farm of 114 pays that 130 times. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
